reviewItem.question: Does "External secret stores: Status: alpha feature, unmaintained If you're using external secret stores, migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets…" mean a change to migration:crossplane|name=external-secret-stores (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The alpha, unmaintained external secret stores feature is removed in Crossplane v2; users must migrate to native Kubernetes secrets or External Secrets Operator before upgrading.
